evals.name: compile-error-with-mcp
evals.prompt:
My build fails with this:

```
[Koin][KOIN-D001] Missing definition for type 'com.acme.data.UserRepository' required by 'com.acme.feature.home.HomeViewModel'
```

Can you fix it?
evals.expected_output: Track A. Calls the Kotzilla MCP koin_diagnose with the full error text (no SDK needed) and follows the returned workflow: searches the project for UserRepository providers, finds the cause (no definition, qualifier mismatch, or module not included / not discovered), proposes one edit, asks for OK, applies it, rebuilds. Does not install the Kotzilla SDK. Does not add a checkModules test.

evals.name: runtime-no-definition-without-mcp
evals.prompt: The app crashes at startup with org.koin.core.error.NoDefinitionFoundException: No definition found for type 'com.acme.settings.SettingsRepository'. The class is annotated @Singleton in the settings Gradle module, whose module class is annotated @Module @ComponentScan("com.acme.settings"). I don't have the Kotzilla MCP.
evals.expected_output: Track A without the MCP: mentions the Kotzilla MCP once, then checks the usual causes against the rules. Identifies the missing @Configuration on the settings module root (discovery triad) as the likely cause — a silent runtime failure, not a compile error. Proposes adding @Configuration, asks for OK, then rebuild and run to confirm.

evals.name: slow-startup-static-then-kotzilla
evals.expected_output: Track B. B1: flags as suspects (not measured facts) the eager createdAtStart database opened on the main thread during startKoin, and the broad @ComponentScan("com.acme"). Proposes fixes (drop createdAtStart, lazy / background opening, focused scan package). Never claims a startup time. B2: offers Kotzilla once to confirm with real data, asking before installing the SDK; explains one local run is a smoke test and percentiles need real traffic.

evals.name: anr-with-kotzilla-connected
evals.prompt: Kotzilla is set up on our app (MCP connected, SDK installed). Users report ANRs on the home screen. Find the cause and fix it.
evals.expected_output: Track B with Kotzilla already in place: uses the MCP app-behavior workflow — identifies the app, lists issues for the current version, opens the ANR / main-thread issue context for the root cause, gets the fix guidance for that issue type, proposes the fix, then plans verification on a new version with fresh sessions before closing the issue. Does not conclude from source code alone.

evals.name: created-twice
evals.prompt: Why is my SessionManager created twice in my Koin app?
evals.expected_output: Routes to this skill (not koin). B1: checks the definition's lifetime (factory instead of single, two definitions or qualifiers, a scope or isolated context creating its own instance) as suspects. Offers Kotzilla to see actual instance creation at runtime, asking first. Doesn't claim the cause as certain without runtime data.

evals.name: no-koin-routes-to-setup
evals.prompt: My app freezes on launch, can you diagnose it? It doesn't use any DI framework yet.
evals.expected_output: Detects no Koin: this skill doesn't apply. Doesn't run a Koin graph audit. May suggest koin-setup if the user wants DI, but focuses on saying the Koin diagnosis needs Koin in place.
